fr.L: jusqu’à un mois de jours, jusqu’à ce qu’elle vous sorte par le nez et qu’elle vous devienne répugnante, parce que vous avez rejeté {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui [est] au milieu de vous, et que vous avez pleuré devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, en disant : ‘Pourquoi [est-ce] donc [que] nous sommes sortis d’Égypte ?’” »
fr.B: mais pendant un mois entier, jusqu’à ce qu’elle vous sorte par les narines et vous dégoûte. Car vous avez rejeté {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est au milieu de vous, et vous avez gémi devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} : ‘Pourquoi donc sommes-nous sortis d’Égypte ?’” »
fr.R: Vous en mangerez pendant un mois entier, jusqu’à ce que vous en ayez tellement assez qu’elle vous sorte par le nez ! Cela arrivera parce que vous vous êtes détournés {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui est ici, tout près de vous. Vous avez pleuré devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} en demandant pourquoi vous étiez sortis d’Égypte.” »

sw.L: hata mwezi mzima wa siku, mpaka itakapowatoka puani na kuwa chukizo kwenu, kwa sababu mmemkataa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliye katikati yenu, na mmelia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mkisema, "Kwa nini [jambo] hili, [kwamba] tulitoka Misri?"'"
sw.B: bali kwa mwezi mzima, mpaka iwatoke puani na kuwachukiza. Kwa maana mmemkataa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliye kati yenu, mkalalamika mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, "Kwa nini tulitoka Misri?"'"
sw.R: Mtaila kwa mwezi mzima, mpaka mtakapoichoka sana hata iwatoke puani! Hili litatokea kwa sababu mmemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliye hapa pamoja nanyi. Mlilia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kuuliza kwa nini mlitoka Misri.'"

vi.L: nhưng cho đến trọn một tháng, cho đến khi nó trào ra lỗ mũi các ngươi và trở thành điều ghê tởm cho các ngươi, vì các ngươi đã khước từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng ở] giữa các ngươi, và đã khóc lóc trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà rằng: "Sao chúng ta lại ra khỏi Ai Cập?"'"
vi.B: nhưng trọn một tháng, cho đến khi thịt trào ra lỗ mũi và các ngươi ngán đến tận cổ. Vì các ngươi đã khước từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Đấng ở giữa các ngươi, và đã khóc lóc trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Tại sao chúng ta lại bỏ Ai Cập mà đi?"'"
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ ăn suốt một tháng, cho đến khi ngán đến nỗi thịt trào ra cả lỗ mũi! Việc này sẽ xảy ra vì các ngươi đã quay lưng lại với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Đấng đang ở ngay giữa các ngươi. Các ngươi đã khóc lóc với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và hỏi tại sao mình lại rời bỏ Ai Cập.'"

decisions.choice: until it comes out of your nose and becomes loathsome: until you are sick of it
decisions.reason: The picture is of eating so much that it comes back up. The rare word "loathsome" means something that disgusts. The meat they crave will become something they cannot stand.

decisions.choice: you have rejected Yahweh who is among you
decisions.reason: God names what the weeping means. To long for Egypt is to reject the God who brought them out and who lives among them in the tabernacle (5:3; Exodus 29:45). The same verb for rejecting appears in 14:31.

decisions.choice: a month of days: a full month
decisions.reason: "A month of days" means a whole month, the full count of its days, as in Genesis 29:14.

decisions.choice: asked why you ever left Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable gives the people's question as reported speech, so that the quotation within a quotation within God's speech is easier to follow.

source.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ מֹשֶׁה֒ שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ רַגְלִ֔י הָעָ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֗רְתָּ בָּשָׂר֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם וְאָכְל֖וּ חֹ֥דֶשׁ יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Moses, six hundred thousand on foot [are] the people which I [am] in its midst, and you, you have said, meat I will give to them, and they will eat a month of days.

en.L: And Moses said, "600,000 on foot [are] the people in whose midst I [am], and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have said, 'Meat I will give to them, and they will eat a month of days.'
en.B: But Moses said, "I am among a people of 600,000 men on foot, and yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say, 'I will give them meat, and they will eat it for a whole month!'
en.R: But Moses said, "There are 600,000 men here with me, besides the rest of the people. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say, 'I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!'

es.L: Y dijo Moisés: «600 000 de a pie [es] el pueblo en medio del cual [estoy] yo, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has dicho: “Carne les daré, y comerán un mes de días”.
es.B: Pero Moisés dijo: «Estoy en medio de un pueblo de 600 000 hombres de a pie, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dices: “¡Les daré carne, y la comerán durante un mes entero!”.
es.R: Pero Moisés respondió: «Aquí conmigo hay 600 000 hombres, además del resto del pueblo. Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dices: “¡Les voy a dar carne para que coman un mes entero!”.

fr.L: Et Moïse dit : « 600 000 [hommes] à pied, [voilà] le peuple au milieu duquel je [suis] ; et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit : “De la viande, je leur en donnerai, et ils en mangeront un mois de jours.”
fr.B: Mais Moïse dit : « Je suis au milieu d’un peuple de 600 000 hommes à pied, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis : “Je leur donnerai de la viande, et ils en mangeront pendant un mois entier !”
fr.R: Mais Moïse a dit : « Il y a ici avec moi 600 000 hommes, sans compter le reste du peuple. Et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis : “Je vais leur donner de la viande à manger pendant un mois entier !”

sw.L: Na Musa akasema, "[Hawa ni] watu 600,000 waendao kwa miguu, ambao mimi [niko] katikati yao, na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umesema, 'Nyama nitawapa, nao watakula mwezi mzima wa siku.'
sw.B: Lakini Musa alisema, "Mimi niko katikati ya watu wanaume 600,000 waendao kwa miguu, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unasema, 'Nitawapa nyama, nao wataila kwa mwezi mzima!'
sw.R: Lakini Musa alisema, "Hapa pamoja nami kuna wanaume 600,000, bila kuhesabu watu wengine. Na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unasema, 'Nitawapa nyama ya kula kwa mwezi mzima!'

vi.L: Và Môi-se thưa: "Sáu trăm ngàn người đi bộ [là] dân mà con [ở] giữa họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán: 'Ta sẽ cho họ thịt, và họ sẽ ăn trọn một tháng.'
vi.B: Nhưng Môi-se thưa: "Dân mà con đang ở giữa có đến sáu trăm ngàn người đàn ông đi bộ, thế mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại phán: 'Ta sẽ cho họ thịt, và họ sẽ ăn suốt một tháng!'
vi.R: Nhưng Môi-se thưa: "Ở đây với con có sáu trăm ngàn người đàn ông, chưa kể những người khác. Thế mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại phán: 'Ta sẽ cho họ thịt ăn suốt một tháng!'

decisions.choice: on foot: men who march on foot, the fighting men
decisions.reason: The word means foot soldiers or men on foot. The number matches the 600,000 men on foot who left Egypt, besides children (Exodus 12:37), and is a round figure for the census total of 603,550 (1:46). On the size of numbers given in "thousands", see the decision on the census in chapter 1.

decisions.choice: and you, you have said: Moses sets God's promise against the size of the people
decisions.reason: Moses writes out "you" to stress it. He is not refusing to believe, but he cannot see how the promise can be kept for so many.

decisions.choice: besides the rest of the people
decisions.reason: The number counts only the men (Exodus 12:37). Readable adds that the rest of the people are more besides, so that a young reader does not take 600,000 as the whole people.

source.text: הֲצֹ֧אן וּבָקָ֛ר יִשָּׁחֵ֥ט לָהֶ֖ם וּמָצָ֣א לָהֶ֑ם אִ֣ם אֶֽת־כָּל־דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֛ם יֵאָסֵ֥ף לָהֶ֖ם וּמָצָ֥א לָהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Flock and herd, will they be slaughtered for them, and will one find for them? Or all [the] fish of the sea will be gathered for them, and will one find for them?

en.L: Will flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, and will it be enough for them? Or will all the fish of the sea be gathered for them, and will it be enough for them?"
en.B: If flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? If all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?"
en.R: Even if we killed all our sheep and cattle, would that be enough for them? Even if we caught all the fish in the sea, would that be enough?"

es.L: ¿Se degollarán para ellos ovejas y vacas, y les bastará? ¿O se juntarán para ellos todos los peces del mar, y les bastará?».
es.B: Si se mataran para ellos rebaños de ovejas y de vacas, ¿tendrían suficiente? Si se pescaran para ellos todos los peces del mar, ¿tendrían suficiente?».
es.R: Aunque matáramos todas nuestras ovejas y vacas, ¿les alcanzaría? Aunque pescáramos todos los peces del mar, ¿alcanzaría?».

fr.L: Égorgera-t-on pour eux du petit et du gros bétail, et [cela] leur suffira-t-il ? Ou rassemblera-t-on pour eux tous les poissons de la mer, et [cela] leur suffira-t-il ? »
fr.B: Si l’on abattait pour eux des troupeaux de moutons et de bœufs, en auraient-ils assez ? Si l’on pêchait pour eux tous les poissons de la mer, en auraient-ils assez ? »
fr.R: Même si nous tuions tous nos moutons et toutes nos vaches, est-ce que ce serait assez pour eux ? Même si nous attrapions tous les poissons de la mer, est-ce que ce serait assez ? »

sw.L: Je, makundi ya kondoo na ng'ombe yatachinjwa kwa ajili yao, nayo yatawatosha? Au samaki wote wa baharini watakusanywa kwa ajili yao, nao watawatosha?"
sw.B: Hata kama kondoo na ng'ombe wangechinjwa kwa ajili yao, je, wangetosheka? Hata kama samaki wote wa baharini wangevuliwa kwa ajili yao, je, wangetosheka?"
sw.R: Hata kama tungewachinja kondoo na ng'ombe wetu wote, je, wangetosha kwa ajili yao? Hata kama tungevua samaki wote wa baharini, je, wangetosha?"

vi.L: Có phải người ta sẽ giết bầy chiên dê và bầy bò cho họ, và [có đủ] cho họ không? Hay mọi cá dưới biển sẽ được gom lại cho họ, và [có đủ] cho họ không?"
vi.B: Dù có giết hết bầy chiên dê và bầy bò cho họ, liệu có đủ cho họ không? Dù có bắt hết cá dưới biển cho họ, liệu có đủ cho họ không?"
vi.R: Dù chúng con có giết hết chiên, dê và bò của mình, liệu có đủ cho họ không? Dù chúng con có bắt hết cá dưới biển, liệu có đủ không?"

decisions.choice: will one find for them: will it be enough for them
decisions.reason: "Find for them" means "suffice for them", "be enough". Moses' questions expect the answer no: not even all the animals or all the fish would be enough for so many.

decisions.choice: flock and herd: sheep and goats, and cattle
decisions.reason: "Flock" means sheep and goats; "herd" means cattle. Israel had brought large flocks and herds from Egypt (Exodus 12:38), but to slaughter them would destroy the people's wealth.

decisions.choice: all our sheep and cattle
decisions.reason: Readable names the animals and adds "all" to make plain the size of what Moses imagines; the Hebrew uses "all" for the fish.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הֲיַ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה תִּקְצָ֑ר עַתָּ֥ה תִרְאֶ֛ה הֲיִקְרְךָ֥ דְבָרִ֖י אִם־לֹֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Moses, [is the] hand of Yahweh short? Now you will see whether will happen to you my word or not.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Is the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} short? Now you will see whether {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} word will happen for you or not."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Is the reach of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} too short? Now you will see whether {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} word comes about for you or not."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered Moses, "Do you think {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is not strong enough? Now you will see whether I do what I said or not."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés: «¿Es corta la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Ahora verás si {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} palabra se cumple para ti o no».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió a Moisés: «¿Es demasiado corto el alcance {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Ahora verás si {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} palabra se cumple para ti o no».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le contestó a Moisés: «¿Crees que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no tiene suficiente poder? Ahora verás si hago lo que dije o no».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « La main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est-elle courte ? Maintenant tu verras si {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} parole s’accomplira pour toi ou non. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Le bras {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} serait-il trop court ? Tu vas voir maintenant si {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} parole se réalise pour toi ou non. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a répondu à Moïse : « Penses-tu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’est pas assez fort ? Tu vas voir maintenant si je fais ce que j’ai dit ou non. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Je, mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mfupi? Sasa utaona kama neno {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litakutokea au la."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Je, mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mfupi mno usiweze kufika? Sasa utaona kama neno {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litatimia kwako au la."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimjibu Musa, "Je, unadhani {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hana nguvu za kutosha? Sasa utaona kama nitafanya nilivyosema au la."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Môi-se: "Tay của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngắn sao? Bây giờ ngươi sẽ thấy lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có xảy đến cho ngươi hay không."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Môi-se: "Cánh tay của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngắn quá sao? Bây giờ ngươi sẽ thấy lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có thành sự cho ngươi hay không."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trả lời Môi-se: "Con nghĩ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không đủ sức sao? Bây giờ con sẽ thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói hay không."

decisions.choice: is the hand of Yahweh short?: is Yahweh's power limited?
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power. A short hand cannot reach far enough to save or to give (Isaiah 50:2; 59:1). God speaks of himself by his name, as if to say: do you think Yahweh cannot do this?

decisions.choice: whether my word will happen for you: whether what I have said will come true
decisions.reason: "My word" is God's promise of meat in verses 18-20. Moses will see it fulfilled with his own eyes (verse 31).

decisions.choice: the reach of the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of a hand that cannot reach far enough, in a form English can follow. Literal keeps "hand ... short"; Readable gives the sense.

decisions.choice: "le bras du SEIGNEUR serait-il trop court ?" for the reach
decisions.reason: French pictures power and reach with the arm ("avoir le bras long"), so Balanced keeps the picture of a reach that falls short (r-en-1) with "bras". Literal keeps "la main".

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֶּאֱסֹ֞ף שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וַֽיַּעֲמֵ֥ד אֹתָ֖ם סְבִיבֹ֥ת הָאֹֽהֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out Moses and spoke to the people the words of Yahweh, and gathered seventy man from [the] elders of the people, and stationed them around the tent.

en.L: And Moses went out and spoke to the people the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he gathered seventy men from the elders of the people and stationed them around the tent.
en.B: So Moses went out and told the people what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said. He gathered seventy men from the elders of the people and had them stand around the tent.
en.R: So Moses went out and told the people what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said. Then he brought together seventy of the elders and had them stand around the meeting tent.

es.L: Y salió Moisés y dijo al pueblo las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y reunió setenta hombres de los ancianos del pueblo y los colocó alrededor de la tienda.
es.B: Moisés salió, pues, y comunicó al pueblo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho. Reunió a setenta hombres de entre los ancianos del pueblo y los hizo estar de pie alrededor de la tienda.
es.R: Entonces Moisés salió y le contó al pueblo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho. Luego reunió a setenta de los ancianos y los puso de pie alrededor de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et Moïse sortit et dit au peuple les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il rassembla soixante-dix hommes d’entre les anciens du peuple et les plaça autour de la tente.
fr.B: Moïse sortit donc et rapporta au peuple ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit. Il réunit soixante-dix hommes parmi les anciens du peuple et les fit se tenir autour de la tente.
fr.R: Alors Moïse est sorti et a dit au peuple ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit. Puis il a réuni soixante-dix anciens et les a fait se tenir autour de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na Musa akatoka, akawaambia watu maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akakusanya watu sabini katika wazee wa watu, akawasimamisha kulizunguka hema.
sw.B: Basi Musa alitoka, akawaambia watu yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyasema. Akawakusanya watu sabini miongoni mwa wazee wa watu, akawasimamisha kulizunguka hema.
sw.R: Basi Musa alitoka, akawaambia watu yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyokuwa amesema. Kisha akawakusanya wazee sabini, akawasimamisha kulizunguka Hema la Kukutania.

vi.L: Và Môi-se đi ra và nói với dân chúng những lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ông tập hợp bảy mươi người trong các trưởng lão của dân và cho họ đứng chung quanh lều.
vi.B: Vậy Môi-se đi ra và nói cho dân chúng biết những lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán. Ông tập hợp bảy mươi người trong các trưởng lão của dân và cho họ đứng chung quanh lều.
vi.R: Vậy Môi-se đi ra và nói cho dân chúng biết những gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán. Rồi ông tập hợp bảy mươi trưởng lão và cho họ đứng chung quanh Lều Hội Kiến.

decisions.choice: the tent: the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: "The tent" is the tent of meeting named in verse 16. Moses goes out from it to the people and brings the elders back to stand around it. In Exodus 33:7 a tent of meeting stood outside the camp, and verses 26 and 30 also picture the elders going out of the camp to the tent and coming back.

decisions.choice: the meeting tent
decisions.reason: Readable names the tent, so the reader knows which tent is meant.

source.text: וַיֵּ֨רֶד יְהוָ֥ה׀בֶּעָנָן֮ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָיו֒ וַיָּ֗אצֶל מִן־הָר֨וּחַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֕ן עַל־שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ הַזְּקֵנִ֑ים וַיְהִ֗י כְּנ֤וֹחַ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָר֔וּחַ וַיִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ וְלֹ֥א יָסָֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And came down Yahweh in the cloud and spoke to him, and took away from the spirit which [was] on him and put on seventy man the elders; and it was, when rested on them the spirit, and they prophesied, and not they did again.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and took away some of the Spirit that [was] on him and put [it] on the seventy men, the elders; and it happened, when the Spirit rested on them, that they prophesied, but they did not do [it] again.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came down in the cloud and spoke to him. He took some of the Spirit that was on Moses and put it on the seventy elders. As soon as the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did not do so again.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came down in the cloud and spoke to Moses. He took some of the Spirit that was on Moses and put the Spirit on the seventy elders. When the Spirit came on them, they began to speak like prophets. But they did this only that one time.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} descendió en la nube y le habló, y tomó del Espíritu que [estaba] sobre él y [lo] puso sobre los setenta varones, los ancianos; y sucedió que, cuando reposó sobre ellos el Espíritu, profetizaron, pero no [lo] volvieron a hacer.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} descendió en la nube y le habló. Tomó parte del Espíritu que estaba sobre Moisés y lo puso sobre los setenta ancianos. En cuanto el Espíritu reposó sobre ellos, profetizaron, pero no volvieron a hacerlo.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bajó en la nube y habló con Moisés. Tomó parte del Espíritu que estaba sobre Moisés y puso el Espíritu sobre los setenta ancianos. Cuando el Espíritu vino sobre ellos, comenzaron a hablar como profetas. Pero solo lo hicieron esa vez.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} descendit dans la nuée et lui parla, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prit de l’Esprit qui [était] sur lui et [le] mit sur les soixante-dix hommes, les anciens ; et il arriva que, lorsque l’Esprit reposa sur eux, ils prophétisèrent, mais ils ne [le] firent plus.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} descendit dans la nuée et lui parla. Il prit une part de l’Esprit qui était sur Moïse et la mit sur les soixante-dix anciens. Dès que l’Esprit reposa sur eux, ils prophétisèrent, mais ils ne le firent plus ensuite.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est descendu dans la nuée et a parlé à Moïse. Il a pris une partie de l’Esprit qui était sur Moïse, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis l’Esprit sur les soixante-dix anciens. Quand l’Esprit est venu sur eux, ils se sont mis à parler comme des prophètes. Mais ils ne l’ont fait que cette fois-là.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akashuka katika wingu, akasema naye, akachukua sehemu ya Roho aliyekuwa juu yake, akamweka juu ya watu sabini, wale wazee; ikawa Roho alipotua juu yao, wakatabiri, lakini hawakufanya [hivyo] tena.
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliposhuka katika wingu, akasema na Musa. Akachukua sehemu ya Roho aliyekuwa juu ya Musa, akamweka juu ya wale wazee sabini. Mara Roho alipotua juu yao, wakatabiri, lakini hawakufanya hivyo tena.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alishuka katika wingu, akaongea na Musa. Akachukua sehemu ya Roho aliyekuwa juu ya Musa, akamweka Roho huyo juu ya wale wazee sabini. Roho alipowajia, walianza kusema kama manabii. Lakini walifanya hivyo mara hiyo moja tu.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự xuống trong đám mây và phán với ông, và lấy [một phần] Thần Linh [ở] trên ông mà đặt trên bảy mươi người, là các trưởng lão; và xảy ra, khi Thần Linh ngự trên họ, thì họ nói tiên tri, nhưng họ không làm [như vậy] nữa.
vi.B: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự xuống trong đám mây và phán với ông. Ngài lấy một phần Thần Linh ở trên Môi-se mà đặt trên bảy mươi trưởng lão. Ngay khi Thần Linh ngự trên họ, họ nói tiên tri, nhưng sau đó họ không làm như vậy nữa.
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự xuống trong đám mây và phán với Môi-se. Ngài lấy một phần Thần Linh đang ở trên Môi-se mà đặt trên bảy mươi trưởng lão. Khi Thần Linh ngự trên họ, họ bắt đầu nói như các nhà tiên tri. Nhưng họ chỉ làm như vậy một lần đó mà thôi.

decisions.choice: they prophesied: they spoke and acted as prophets, moved by the Spirit
decisions.reason: The verb form here describes behaving as a prophet. It does not say that they spoke a message about the future. As with Saul in 1 Samuel 10:5-13 and 19:20-24, it was an outward sign, seen and heard by others, that God's Spirit had come on them.

decisions.choice: they did not do it again: it happened this one time
decisions.reason: The verb means "add, do again". The prophesying was a sign, given once, that God had put his Spirit on the seventy. Some early translations read the same letters as a verb meaning "stop", giving "and they did not stop". The Hebrew as written reads "they did not do it again".

decisions.choice: Yahweh came down in the cloud
decisions.reason: God does what he promised in verse 17. The cloud marked his presence over the tent (9:15-16; 12:5; Exodus 33:9).

decisions.choice: Moses for "him"
decisions.reason: In Hebrew "him" can only be Moses here. Balanced and Readable write the name, since in English "him" might seem to mean God.

source.text: וַיִּשָּׁאֲר֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי־אֲנָשִׁ֣ים׀בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֡ה שֵׁ֣ם הָאֶחָ֣ד׀אֶלְדָּ֡ד וְשֵׁם֩ הַשֵּׁנִ֨י מֵידָ֜ד וַתָּ֧נַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם הָר֗וּחַ וְהֵ֨מָּה֙ בַּכְּתֻבִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָצְא֖וּ הָאֹ֑הֱלָה וַיִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And remained two men in the camp; [the] name of the one Eldad, and [the] name of the second Medad, and rested on them the spirit; and they [were] among the written, and not they had gone out to the tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

en.L: And two men had remained in the camp; the name of the one [was] Eldad, and the name of the second Medad, and the Spirit rested on them; and they [were] among those written, but they had not gone out to the tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
en.B: Two men, however, had stayed behind in the camp, one named Eldad and the other Medad. The Spirit rested on them too. They were among those listed, but they had not gone out to the tent, and they prophesied in the camp.
en.R: But two men named Eldad and Medad had stayed in the camp. Their names were on the list of elders, but they had not gone out to the tent. The Spirit came on them too, and they began to speak like prophets right there in the camp.

es.L: Y habían quedado dos hombres en el campamento; el nombre del uno [era] Eldad, y el nombre del segundo Medad, y reposó sobre ellos el Espíritu; y ellos [estaban] entre los inscritos, pero no habían salido a la tienda; y profetizaron en el campamento.
es.B: Sin embargo, dos hombres se habían quedado en el campamento; uno se llamaba Eldad y el otro Medad. El Espíritu reposó también sobre ellos. Estaban entre los inscritos, pero no habían salido a la tienda, y profetizaron en el campamento.
es.R: Pero dos hombres, Eldad y Medad, se habían quedado en el campamento. Sus nombres estaban en la lista de los ancianos, pero no habían ido a la tienda. El Espíritu vino también sobre ellos, y comenzaron a hablar como profetas allí mismo, en el campamento.

fr.L: Et deux hommes étaient restés dans le camp ; le nom de l’un [était] Eldad, et le nom du second Médad, et l’Esprit reposa sur eux ; et ils [étaient] parmi les inscrits, mais ils n’étaient pas sortis vers la tente ; et ils prophétisèrent dans le camp.
fr.B: Deux hommes, cependant, étaient restés dans le camp ; l’un s’appelait Eldad et l’autre Médad. L’Esprit reposa aussi sur eux. Ils faisaient partie des inscrits, mais ils n’étaient pas sortis vers la tente, et ils prophétisèrent dans le camp.
fr.R: Mais deux hommes, Eldad et Médad, étaient restés dans le camp. Leurs noms étaient sur la liste des anciens, mais ils n’étaient pas allés jusqu’à la tente. L’Esprit est venu sur eux aussi, et ils se sont mis à parler comme des prophètes, là, dans le camp.

sw.L: Na watu wawili walikuwa wamebaki kambini; jina la mmoja [lilikuwa] Eldadi, na jina la wa pili Medadi, na Roho akatua juu yao; nao [walikuwa] miongoni mwa walioandikwa, lakini hawakuwa wametoka kwenda hemani; nao wakatabiri kambini.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, watu wawili walikuwa wamebaki kambini, mmoja aitwaye Eldadi na mwingine Medadi. Roho akatua juu yao pia. Walikuwa miongoni mwa walioorodheshwa, lakini hawakuwa wametoka kwenda hemani, nao wakatabiri kambini.
sw.R: Lakini watu wawili, Eldadi na Medadi, walikuwa wamebaki kambini. Majina yao yalikuwa katika orodha ya wazee, lakini hawakuwa wamekwenda hemani. Roho akawajia nao pia, wakaanza kusema kama manabii papo hapo kambini.

vi.L: Và hai người đã ở lại trong trại quân; tên của một người [là] Ên-đát, và tên của người thứ hai [là] Mê-đát, và Thần Linh ngự trên họ; và họ [ở] trong số những người đã được ghi tên, nhưng họ đã không đi ra lều; và họ nói tiên tri trong trại quân.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, có hai người đã ở lại trong trại quân, một người tên Ên-đát và người kia tên Mê-đát. Thần Linh cũng ngự trên họ. Họ ở trong số những người đã được ghi tên, nhưng đã không đi ra lều, và họ nói tiên tri trong trại quân.
vi.R: Nhưng có hai người tên là Ên-đát và Mê-đát đã ở lại trong khu trại. Tên họ có trong danh sách các trưởng lão, nhưng họ đã không đi ra lều. Thần Linh cũng ngự trên họ, và họ bắt đầu nói như các nhà tiên tri ngay trong khu trại.

decisions.choice: among those written: on the list of the seventy
decisions.reason: "Written" means their names had been recorded. They were among the elders chosen in verse 16, though the text does not say why they did not go out to the tent.

decisions.choice: the Spirit rested on them in the camp
decisions.reason: The Spirit came on these two away from the tent and away from Moses. God's gift is not bound to the place where Moses stood, which is the point of Moses' answer in verse 29.

decisions.choice: the list first, then the Spirit
decisions.reason: Readable explains first who the two men were, then tells what happened, so that the story is easier to follow.

source.text: וַיָּ֣רָץ הַנַּ֔עַר וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לְמֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֶלְדָּ֣ד וּמֵידָ֔ד מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And ran the young man and told Moses and said, Eldad and Medad [are] prophesying in the camp.

en.L: And the young man ran and told Moses, and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
en.B: A young man ran and told Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!"
en.R: A young man ran to tell Moses. He said, "Eldad and Medad are speaking like prophets in the camp!"

es.L: Y corrió el joven y avisó a Moisés, y dijo: «Eldad y Medad están profetizando en el campamento».
es.B: Un joven corrió a avisar a Moisés: «¡Eldad y Medad están profetizando en el campamento!».
es.R: Un joven fue corriendo a decírselo a Moisés: «¡Eldad y Medad están hablando como profetas en el campamento!».

fr.L: Et le jeune homme courut, et l’annonça à Moïse, et dit : « Eldad et Médad prophétisent dans le camp. »
fr.B: Un jeune homme courut l’annoncer à Moïse : « Eldad et Médad prophétisent dans le camp ! »
fr.R: Un jeune homme a couru prévenir Moïse. Il lui a dit : « Eldad et Médad parlent comme des prophètes dans le camp ! »

sw.L: Na yule kijana akakimbia, akamwambia Musa, akasema, "Eldadi na Medadi wanatabiri kambini."
sw.B: Kijana mmoja alikimbia akamwambia Musa, "Eldadi na Medadi wanatabiri kambini!"
sw.R: Kijana mmoja alikimbia kwenda kumwambia Musa. Akasema, "Eldadi na Medadi wanasema kama manabii kambini!"

vi.L: Và người thanh niên chạy đến báo cho Môi-se và nói: "Ên-đát và Mê-đát đang nói tiên tri trong trại quân."
vi.B: Một người thanh niên chạy đến báo cho Môi-se: "Ên-đát và Mê-đát đang nói tiên tri trong trại quân!"
vi.R: Một người thanh niên chạy đến báo cho Môi-se. Anh nói: "Ên-đát và Mê-đát đang nói như các nhà tiên tri trong khu trại!"

decisions.choice: the young man: a certain young man, not named
decisions.reason: The article points to one particular young man in the story, but he is not named. Hebrew often uses the article this way for a person who has a part in the scene.

decisions.choice: a young man
decisions.reason: English introduces an unnamed person with "a". Literal keeps "the".

source.text: וַיַּ֜עַן יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִבְּחֻרָ֖יו וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנִ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה כְּלָאֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered Joshua son of Nun, [the] attendant of Moses from his youth, and said, my lord Moses, restrain them.

en.L: And Joshua son of Nun, the attendant of Moses from his youth, answered and said, "My lord Moses, restrain them!"
en.B: Joshua son of Nun, who had served as Moses' assistant since he was young, spoke up: "My lord Moses, stop them!"
en.R: Joshua son of Nun had been Moses' helper since he was a young man. He said, "Moses, sir, make them stop!"

es.L: Y respondió Josué hijo de Nun, servidor de Moisés desde su juventud, y dijo: «¡Mi señor Moisés, detenlos!».
es.B: Josué hijo de Nun, que servía a Moisés desde joven, intervino: «¡Mi señor Moisés, detenlos!».
es.R: Josué hijo de Nun era ayudante de Moisés desde que era joven. Le dijo: «¡Señor Moisés, haz que se callen!».

fr.L: Et Josué, fils de Noun, le serviteur de Moïse depuis sa jeunesse, répondit et dit : « Mon seigneur Moïse, empêche-les ! »
fr.B: Josué, fils de Noun, qui servait Moïse depuis sa jeunesse, intervint : « Mon seigneur Moïse, arrête-les ! »
fr.R: Josué, fils de Noun, était l’assistant de Moïse depuis qu’il était jeune. Il a dit : « Moïse, mon maître, fais-les taire ! »

sw.L: Na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtumishi wa Musa tangu ujana wake, akajibu, akasema, "Bwana wangu Musa, uwazuie!"
sw.B: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, aliyekuwa akimtumikia Musa tangu ujana wake, akasema, "Bwana wangu Musa, wazuie!"
sw.R: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni alikuwa msaidizi wa Musa tangu alipokuwa kijana. Akasema, "Bwana Musa, wanyamazishe!"

vi.L: Và Giô-suê con trai Nun, người hầu cận của Môi-se từ thời trai trẻ, đáp lời và nói: "Thưa chúa tôi Môi-se, xin ngăn cấm họ!"
vi.B: Giô-suê con trai Nun, người đã làm phụ tá cho Môi-se từ khi còn trẻ, lên tiếng: "Thưa chúa tôi Môi-se, xin ngăn họ lại!"
vi.R: Giô-suê con trai Nun đã làm người giúp việc cho Môi-se từ khi còn là một thanh niên. Ông nói: "Thưa ông Môi-se, xin bắt họ dừng lại!"

decisions.choice: from his youth: since he was young, or one of his chosen men
decisions.reason: The word can come from a noun meaning "youth", giving "from his youth", or from one meaning "chosen men", giving "one of his chosen men". Both fit: Joshua was a young man in Moses' service (Exodus 33:11) and had been chosen for tasks such as leading the battle against Amalek (Exodus 17:9).

decisions.choice: attendant: a personal assistant, not a slave
decisions.reason: The word is not the word for a slave. It means one who waits on and helps a leader, and it is used of Joshua in Exodus 24:13 and 33:11 and of Elisha with Elijah (1 Kings 19:21).

decisions.choice: restrain them: hold them back, make them stop
decisions.reason: The verb means to hold back or shut in. Joshua wants Moses to stop the two men, perhaps because they prophesy outside the tent and apart from Moses.

decisions.choice: Moses, sir
decisions.reason: "My lord" is a polite way to speak to a superior. Readable uses "sir", which young readers know as a respectful address.

decisions.choice: "chúa tôi" (L, B), "Thưa ông" (R) for "my lord" addressed to Moses
decisions.reason: As the Genesis sheet for "my lord" said to a man: "chúa tôi", with "ông" at Readable as the English Readable has "sir".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַֽמְקַנֵּ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לִ֑י וּמִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן כָּל־עַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ נְבִיאִ֔ים כִּי־יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־רוּח֖וֹ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to him Moses, jealous [are] you for me? And who will give all [the] people of Yahweh [were] prophets, that would put Yahweh his spirit on them!

en.L: And Moses said to him, "Are you jealous for me? And who will give [that] all the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [were] prophets, that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit on them!"
en.B: But Moses said to him, "Are you being jealous on my behalf? If only {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit on all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and make every one of them a prophet!"
en.R: But Moses said to him, "Are you upset because you are trying to protect my honor? I wish {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit on all of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, so that every one of them could be a prophet!"

es.L: Y Moisés le dijo: «¿Tienes celos por mí? ¡Y quién diera [que] todo el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [fuera] profeta, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pusiera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu sobre ellos!».
es.B: Pero Moisés le respondió: «¿Estás celoso por mí? ¡Ojalá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pusiera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu sobre todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo e hiciera de cada uno de ellos un profeta!».
es.R: Pero Moisés le dijo: «¿Estás molesto porque quieres defender mi honor? ¡Cómo me gustaría que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pusiera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu sobre todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, para que todos pudieran ser profetas!».

fr.L: Et Moïse lui dit : « Es-tu jaloux pour moi ? Et qui donnera [que] tous ceux du peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [soient] prophètes, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mette {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit sur eux ! »
fr.B: Mais Moïse lui répondit : « Es-tu jaloux à ma place ? Si seulement {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mettait {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit sur tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et faisait de chacun d’eux un prophète ! »
fr.R: Mais Moïse lui a dit : « Est-ce que tu es fâché parce que tu veux défendre mon honneur ? Je voudrais tant que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mette {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit sur tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, pour que chacun d’eux puisse être prophète ! »

sw.L: Na Musa akamwambia, "Je, wewe unaona wivu kwa ajili yangu? Na nani atajalia [kwamba] watu wote wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [wangekuwa] manabii, kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} angeweka Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu yao!"
sw.B: Lakini Musa alimwambia, "Je, unaona wivu kwa ajili yangu? Laiti {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} angeweka Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, akamfanya kila mmoja wao kuwa nabii!"
sw.R: Lakini Musa alimwambia, "Je, umekasirika kwa sababu unataka kulinda heshima yangu? Ningependa sana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aweke Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, ili kila mmoja wao aweze kuwa nabii!"

vi.L: Và Môi-se nói với người: "Con ghen thay cho ta sao? Ước gì toàn dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [đều là] những nhà tiên tri, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đặt Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên họ!"
vi.B: Nhưng Môi-se nói với ông: "Con ghen tức thay cho ta sao? Ước gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đặt Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên toàn dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và làm cho ai nấy đều là nhà tiên tri!"
vi.R: Nhưng Môi-se nói với ông: "Con bực tức vì muốn bảo vệ danh dự cho ta sao? Ta ước gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đặt Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên toàn dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để ai nấy đều có thể làm nhà tiên tri!"

decisions.choice: jealous for me: zealous to guard my position
decisions.reason: The verb means burning zeal for someone's rights or honor. Joshua is zealous for Moses' standing as the one through whom God speaks. Moses does not want that kind of protection.

decisions.choice: who will give ...: if only, a strong wish
decisions.reason: "Who will give?" is a Hebrew way of expressing a wish (compare verse 4 and Deuteronomy 5:29). Moses wishes that the gift given to the seventy were given to all God's people. Joel 2:28-29 later promises that God will pour out his Spirit on all.

decisions.choice: the LORD would put his Spirit on all his people and make every one of them a prophet
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the two halves of the wish into one sentence with God as its subject, which reads more naturally. The meaning is the same: all the people prophets, through God's Spirit on them.

decisions.choice: Moses calls Joshua "con" and himself "ta"
decisions.reason: Joshua had served Moses since his youth; Vietnamese speaks from the older master to his young attendant with "ta" and "con", which is warm rather than harsh.

source.text: וַיֵּאָסֵ֥ף מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה ה֖וּא וְזִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And withdrew Moses to the camp, he and [the] elders of Israel.

en.L: And Moses withdrew to the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
en.B: Then Moses and the elders of Israel went back to the camp.
en.R: Then Moses and the elders of Israel went back to the camp.

es.L: Y Moisés se retiró al campamento, él y los ancianos de Israel.
es.B: Luego Moisés regresó al campamento junto con los ancianos de Israel.
es.R: Después, Moisés y los ancianos de Israel volvieron al campamento.

fr.L: Et Moïse se retira dans le camp, lui et les anciens d’Israël.
fr.B: Puis Moïse retourna au camp avec les anciens d’Israël.
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse et les anciens d’Israël sont retournés au camp.

sw.L: Na Musa akarudi kambini, yeye na wazee wa Israeli.
sw.B: Kisha Musa na wazee wa Israeli walirudi kambini.
sw.R: Baadaye Musa na wazee wa Israeli walirudi kambini.

vi.L: Và Môi-se rút về trại quân, ông cùng các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Rồi Môi-se cùng các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về trại quân.
vi.R: Rồi Môi-se cùng các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về khu trại.

decisions.choice: withdrew: gathered himself back, returned
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "be gathered". With "to the camp" it means that Moses went back into the camp from the tent, which stood outside it (Exodus 33:7).

decisions.choice: went back
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the plain verb for returning.

source.text: וְר֜וּחַ נָסַ֣ע׀מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּ֣גָז שַׂלְוִים֮ מִן־הַיָּם֒ וַיִּטֹּ֨שׁ עַל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה כְּדֶ֧רֶךְ י֣וֹם כֹּ֗ה וּכְדֶ֤רֶךְ יוֹם֙ כֹּ֔ה סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וּכְאַמָּתַ֖יִם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And a wind set out from with Yahweh and drove quails from the sea and let fall by the camp, about a way of a day thus and about a way of a day thus, around the camp, and about two cubits on [the] face of the land.

en.L: And a wind went out from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and it drove quail from the sea and let [them] fall beside the camp, about a day's journey this way and about a day's journey that way, around the camp, and about two cubits above the face of the ground.
en.B: Then a wind went out from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It swept quail in from the sea and brought them down beside the camp, for about a day's walk in one direction and a day's walk in the other, all around the camp, about {{units:3 feet|two cubits}} above the ground.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent a wind. It blew in quail from the sea and brought them down around the camp. They covered the ground as far as a person could walk in a day in every direction. They were about {{units:3 feet|two cubits}} above the ground.

es.L: Y un viento salió de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y trajo codornices del mar y [las] dejó caer junto al campamento, como un día de camino por un lado y como un día de camino por el otro, alrededor del campamento, y como a dos codos sobre la faz de la tierra.
es.B: Entonces se levantó un viento enviado por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que trajo codornices desde el mar y las hizo caer junto al campamento, a lo largo de un día de camino en una dirección y un día de camino en la otra, alrededor de todo el campamento, a unos {{units:90 cm|dos codos}} del suelo.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió un viento. Este trajo codornices desde el mar y las hizo bajar alrededor del campamento. Cubrieron el suelo hasta donde una persona podía caminar en un día, en todas las direcciones. Estaban a unos {{units:90 cm|dos codos}} por encima del suelo.

fr.L: Et un vent partit d’auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il amena des cailles de la mer et [les] laissa tomber près du camp, à environ une journée de marche d’un côté et à environ une journée de marche de l’autre, autour du camp, et à environ deux coudées au-dessus de la surface du sol.
fr.B: Alors un vent s’éleva de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il poussa des cailles depuis la mer et les fit s’abattre près du camp, sur environ une journée de marche d’un côté et une journée de marche de l’autre, tout autour du camp, à environ {{units:90 cm|deux coudées}} au-dessus du sol.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé un vent. Ce vent a amené des cailles depuis la mer et les a fait tomber tout autour du camp. Elles couvraient le sol aussi loin qu’on pouvait marcher en une journée, dans toutes les directions. Elles étaient à environ {{units:90 cm|deux coudées}} au-dessus du sol.

sw.L: Na upepo ukatoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukaleta kware kutoka baharini, ukawaangusha kando ya kambi, kama mwendo wa siku moja upande huu na kama mwendo wa siku moja upande ule, kuizunguka kambi, na kama dhiraa mbili juu ya uso wa nchi.
sw.B: Kisha upepo ulivuma kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ukaleta kware kutoka baharini na kuwaangusha kando ya kambi, kwa umbali wa mwendo wa siku moja upande mmoja na mwendo wa siku moja upande mwingine, pande zote za kambi, kama {{units:sentimita 90|dhiraa mbili}} juu ya ardhi.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alituma upepo. Upepo huo ukaleta kware kutoka baharini na kuwashusha kuizunguka kambi. Walifunika ardhi kwa umbali ambao mtu angeweza kutembea kwa siku moja kila upande. Walikuwa kama {{units:sentimita 90|dhiraa mbili}} juu ya ardhi.

vi.L: Và một ngọn gió từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thổi đến, và nó lùa chim cút từ biển đến và để [chúng] rơi xuống bên cạnh trại quân, chừng một ngày đường phía bên này và chừng một ngày đường phía bên kia, chung quanh trại quân, và chừng hai cu-đê trên mặt đất.
vi.B: Bấy giờ một ngọn gió từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thổi đến. Gió lùa chim cút từ biển vào và cho chúng rơi xuống bên cạnh trại quân, chừng một ngày đường về phía này và một ngày đường về phía kia, khắp chung quanh trại quân, cao chừng {{units:90 cm|hai cu-đê}} trên mặt đất.
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai một ngọn gió đến. Gió thổi chim cút từ biển vào và cho chúng rơi xuống chung quanh khu trại. Chim cút phủ kín mặt đất về mọi phía, xa đến mức một người đi bộ cả ngày. Chúng cao chừng {{units:90 cm|hai cu-đê}} trên mặt đất.

decisions.choice: wind: the same word as "spirit"
decisions.reason: The word that means "spirit" in verses 17-29 here means "wind". The God who gave his Spirit to the elders now sends his wind to bring the meat, both coming from him.

decisions.choice: quail: small birds that migrate across the sea
decisions.reason: Quail cross the Mediterranean Sea and the Gulf of Suez in spring and autumn, and tired flocks come down to the ground in great numbers. God fed Israel quail before, in the wilderness of Sin (Exodus 16:13; Psalm 78:26-28).

decisions.choice: about two cubits above the ground: the quail lay piled up, or flew low
alternatives: flying about two cubits above the ground
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean the quail lay heaped on the ground to a depth of about two cubits, or that they flew about two cubits above the ground, low enough to be caught by hand. Both readings have long been held; verse 32, where the people gather them for two days, fits either.

decisions.choice: about 3 feet, with two cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: A cubit is about 18 inches, so two cubits are about 3 feet. Literal keeps "two cubits".

decisions.choice: as far as a person could walk in a day in every direction
decisions.reason: Readable explains "a day's journey this way and a day's journey that way".

source.text: וַיָּ֣קָם הָעָ֡ם כָּל־הַיּוֹם֩ הַה֨וּא וְכָל־הַלַּ֜יְלָה וְכֹ֣ל׀י֣וֹם הַֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת וַיַּֽאַסְפוּ֙ אֶת־הַשְּׂלָ֔ו הַמַּמְעִ֕יט אָסַ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֣ה חֳמָרִ֑ים וַיִּשְׁטְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ שָׁט֔וֹחַ סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And rose the people all the day the that and all the night and all [the] day of the next day, and gathered the quail; the [one] gathering least gathered ten homers; and spread out for themselves spreading around the camp.

en.L: And the people rose up all that day and all the night and all the next day and gathered the quail; the [one who] gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread [them] out for themselves all around the camp.
en.B: The people were up all that day, all night and all the next day gathering the quail. The one who gathered least gathered {{units:about 60 bushels|ten homers}}. They spread them out for themselves all around the camp.
en.R: So the people stayed up all that day, all that night and all the next day, gathering quail. Even the person who gathered the least gathered {{units:about 60 bushels|ten homers}}. Then they spread the birds out all around the camp to dry them.

es.L: Y se levantó el pueblo todo aquel día, y toda la noche, y todo el día siguiente, y recogieron las codornices; el que menos recogió, recogió diez homeres; y [las] tendieron para sí alrededor del campamento.
es.B: El pueblo estuvo en pie todo aquel día, toda la noche y todo el día siguiente recogiendo codornices. El que menos recogió juntó {{units:unos 2 200 litros|diez homeres}}. Las tendieron para sí alrededor de todo el campamento.
es.R: Así que el pueblo pasó en pie todo ese día, toda esa noche y todo el día siguiente recogiendo codornices. Hasta el que recogió menos juntó {{units:unos 2 200 litros|diez homeres}}. Luego extendieron las aves alrededor de todo el campamento para secarlas.

fr.L: Et le peuple se leva tout ce jour-là, et toute la nuit, et tout le jour du lendemain, et ramassa les cailles ; celui [qui en] ramassa le moins [en] ramassa dix homers ; et ils [les] étalèrent pour eux tout autour du camp.
fr.B: Le peuple resta debout tout ce jour-là, toute la nuit et tout le lendemain à ramasser les cailles. Celui qui en ramassa le moins en eut {{units:environ 2 200 litres|dix homers}}. Ils les étalèrent pour eux tout autour du camp.
fr.R: Alors le peuple est resté debout tout ce jour-là, toute cette nuit-là et tout le jour suivant, à ramasser des cailles. Même celui qui en a ramassé le moins en a eu {{units:environ 2 200 litres|dix homers}}. Ensuite, ils ont étalé les oiseaux tout autour du camp pour les faire sécher.

sw.L: Na watu wakaondoka mchana ule wote, na usiku wote, na mchana wote wa siku iliyofuata, wakakusanya kware; yeye aliyekusanya wachache kuliko wote alikusanya homeri kumi; nao wakawatandaza kwa ajili yao kuizunguka kambi pote.
sw.B: Watu walishughulika mchana ule wote, usiku wote na mchana wote wa siku iliyofuata, wakikusanya kware. Aliyekusanya wachache kuliko wote alikusanya {{units:kama lita 2,200|homeri kumi}}. Wakawatandaza kwa ajili yao kuizunguka kambi pote.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu hawakulala mchana ule wote, usiku ule wote na mchana wote wa siku iliyofuata, wakikusanya kware. Hata yule aliyekusanya wachache kuliko wote alikusanya {{units:kama lita 2,200|homeri kumi}}. Kisha wakawatandaza ndege hao kuizunguka kambi pote ili wakauke.

vi.L: Và dân chúng đứng dậy suốt ngày ấy, suốt đêm và suốt ngày hôm sau và lượm chim cút; người lượm ít nhất được mười hô-me; và họ phơi [chúng] ra cho mình khắp chung quanh trại quân.
vi.B: Suốt ngày hôm ấy, suốt đêm và suốt ngày hôm sau, dân chúng thức dậy lượm chim cút. Người lượm ít nhất cũng được {{units:khoảng 2.200 lít|mười hô-me}}. Họ phơi chim cút ra cho mình khắp chung quanh trại quân.
vi.R: Vậy dân chúng thức suốt ngày hôm ấy, suốt đêm đó và suốt ngày hôm sau để lượm chim cút. Ngay cả người lượm ít nhất cũng được {{units:khoảng 2.200 lít|mười hô-me}}. Rồi họ phơi chim cút ra khắp chung quanh khu trại cho khô.

decisions.choice: ten homers: a huge amount
decisions.reason: A homer was the largest dry measure, about 6 bushels (the load of a donkey), so ten homers is about 60 bushels. Even the one who gathered least took far more than anyone could eat.

decisions.choice: spread out for themselves: laid out to dry
decisions.reason: Meat was dried in the sun to keep it, as fish was dried in Egypt. The people laid the birds out all around the camp to keep them for later.

decisions.choice: all that day and all the night and all the next day: without stopping
decisions.reason: The list of day, night and day shows the people gathering for some thirty-six hours on end, with the craving of verse 4 now out of control.

decisions.choice: to dry them
decisions.reason: Readable says why the birds were spread out, as the culture decision explains.

source.text: הַבָּשָׂ֗ר עוֹדֶ֨נּוּ֙ בֵּ֣ין שִׁנֵּיהֶ֔ם טֶ֖רֶם יִכָּרֵ֑ת וְאַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ חָרָ֣ה בָעָ֔ם וַיַּ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ בָּעָ֔ם מַכָּ֖ה רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: The meat still [was] between their teeth, not yet was it cut off, and [the] anger of Yahweh burned against the people, and struck Yahweh among the people a blow great very.

en.L: The meat [was] still between their teeth, not yet cut off, when the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned against the people, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck the people with a very great plague.
en.B: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it had been chewed, the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} flared up against the people, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck them with a terrible plague.
en.R: The people were still chewing the meat when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} became angry with them. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent a terrible sickness among the people.

es.L: La carne [estaba] aún entre sus dientes, antes de ser cortada, cuando la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se encendió contra el pueblo, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hirió al pueblo con una plaga muy grande.
es.B: Mientras la carne estaba aún entre sus dientes, antes de masticarla, la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se encendió contra el pueblo, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los hirió con una plaga terrible.
es.R: La gente todavía estaba masticando la carne cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó con ellos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió una enfermedad terrible sobre el pueblo.

fr.L: La viande [était] encore entre leurs dents, pas encore coupée, que la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre le peuple, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappa le peuple d’un très grand fléau.
fr.B: La viande était encore entre leurs dents, avant même d’être mâchée, quand la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre le peuple, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les frappa d’un terrible fléau.
fr.R: Les gens mâchaient encore la viande quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis en colère contre eux. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé une terrible maladie parmi le peuple.

sw.L: Nyama [ilikuwa] bado kati ya meno yao, kabla haijakatwa, hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka juu ya watu, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapiga watu pigo kubwa mno.
sw.B: Nyama ilipokuwa bado kati ya meno yao, kabla haijatafunwa, hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iliwaka juu ya watu, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapiga kwa pigo baya sana.
sw.R: Watu walikuwa bado wanatafuna nyama wakati {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipowakasirikia. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaleta ugonjwa mbaya sana kati ya watu.

vi.L: Thịt còn [ở] giữa răng họ, chưa được nhai, thì cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bừng lên nghịch cùng dân chúng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh dân chúng bằng một tai vạ rất lớn.
vi.B: Khi thịt còn đang ở giữa răng, chưa kịp nhai, thì cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bừng lên nghịch cùng dân chúng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng trên họ một tai vạ khủng khiếp.
vi.R: Dân chúng còn đang nhai thịt thì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận với họ. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng một trận bệnh dịch khủng khiếp trên dân chúng.

decisions.choice: not yet cut off: before it was chewed, or before it ran out
decisions.reason: The verb means "be cut off". It may mean that the meat was not yet chewed and swallowed, so that the judgment came at once, while they were eating. Or it may mean that the supply was not yet used up, so that the judgment came during the month of verse 20.

decisions.choice: a blow, very great: a deadly plague
decisions.reason: The word means a blow or stroke, often a plague sent by God (Deuteronomy 28:59). The text does not describe it, but verse 34 shows that many died. Psalm 78:30-31 looks back on this event.

decisions.choice: a terrible sickness
decisions.reason: Readable uses "sickness" for the plague, which young readers may not know as a word for a deadly disease.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא קִבְר֣וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁם֙ קָֽבְר֔וּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם הַמִּתְאַוִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And called [one] the name of the place the that Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people the craving.

en.L: And [one] called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who craved.
en.B: So that place was named Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved.
en.R: So that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, which means "graves of craving." They gave it that name because they buried there the people who had wanted more food so badly.

es.L: Y [se] llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Kibrot-hataavá, porque allí sepultaron al pueblo que había codiciado.
es.B: Por eso aquel lugar recibió el nombre de Kibrot-hataavá, porque allí sepultaron a los que se habían dejado llevar por el antojo.
es.R: Por eso a ese lugar lo llamaron Kibrot-hataavá, que significa «tumbas del deseo». Le pusieron ese nombre porque allí enterraron a la gente que había deseado con tantas ganas más comida.

fr.L: Et [on] appela le nom de ce lieu Kibroth-Hattaava, car c’est là qu’on enterra le peuple qui avait convoité.
fr.B: On donna donc à ce lieu le nom de Kibroth-Hattaava, parce que c’est là qu’on enterra ceux qui s’étaient livrés à la convoitise.
fr.R: C’est pourquoi on a appelé cet endroit Kibroth-Hattaava, ce qui veut dire « tombes de la convoitise ». On lui a donné ce nom parce qu’on y a enterré les gens qui avaient eu une si forte envie de nourriture.

sw.L: Na [mtu] akaliita jina la mahali pale Kibroth-hataava, kwa sababu huko waliwazika watu waliotamani.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo mahali pale paliitwa Kibroth-hataava, kwa sababu huko ndiko walikowazika watu waliokuwa wametamani.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mahali pale paliitwa Kibroth-hataava, maana yake "Makaburi ya tamaa." Walipaita hivyo kwa sababu huko waliwazika watu waliotamani sana chakula zaidi.

vi.L: Và [người ta] gọi tên nơi ấy là Kíp-rốt Ha-tha-a-va, vì tại đó người ta chôn những người đã thèm khát.
vi.B: Vì vậy nơi ấy được gọi là Kíp-rốt Ha-tha-a-va, vì tại đó người ta chôn những người đã thèm khát.
vi.R: Vì vậy nơi ấy được gọi là Kíp-rốt Ha-tha-a-va, nghĩa là "mồ mả của lòng thèm khát". Nơi ấy có tên như vậy vì tại đó người ta chôn những người đã quá thèm ăn.

decisions.choice: Kibroth-hattaavah: "graves of craving"
decisions.reason: The name joins the word for graves to the word for craving in verse 4. It names the place after what happened: those who craved meat were buried there. Israel's later memory of the wilderness recalls the place (33:16; Deuteronomy 9:22).

decisions.choice: the people who craved: those who had given in to the craving
decisions.reason: The verb is the same as in verse 4. The text does not say that every Israelite died, only those who had craved.

decisions.choice: which means "graves of craving"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name, as it does for Taberah in verse 3.

source.text: מִקִּבְר֧וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֛ה נָסְע֥וּ הָעָ֖ם חֲצֵר֑וֹת וַיִּהְי֖וּ בַּחֲצֵרֽוֹת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: From Kibroth-hattaavah set out the people [to] Hazeroth, and they were in Hazeroth.

en.L: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people set out [to] Hazeroth, and they were at Hazeroth.
en.B: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, and they stayed at Hazeroth.
en.R: Then the people left Kibroth-hattaavah and traveled to Hazeroth, and they stayed there.

es.L: De Kibrot-hataavá partió el pueblo [hacia] Hazerot, y estuvieron en Hazerot.
es.B: De Kibrot-hataavá el pueblo siguió hasta Hazerot, y se quedó en Hazerot.
es.R: Después, el pueblo salió de Kibrot-hataavá y viajó hasta Hazerot, y se quedaron allí.

fr.L: De Kibroth-Hattaava le peuple partit [pour] Hatséroth, et ils furent à Hatséroth.
fr.B: De Kibroth-Hattaava, le peuple se rendit à Hatséroth, et ils demeurèrent à Hatséroth.
fr.R: Ensuite, le peuple a quitté Kibroth-Hattaava et a voyagé jusqu’à Hatséroth, et il est resté là.

sw.L: Kutoka Kibroth-hataava watu wakasafiri [hadi] Haserothi, nao wakawa Haserothi.
sw.B: Kutoka Kibroth-hataava watu walisafiri hadi Haserothi, wakakaa Haserothi.
sw.R: Kisha watu waliondoka Kibroth-hataava, wakasafiri mpaka Haserothi, wakakaa huko.

vi.L: Từ Kíp-rốt Ha-tha-a-va dân chúng ra đi [đến] Hát-sê-rốt, và họ ở tại Hát-sê-rốt.
vi.B: Từ Kíp-rốt Ha-tha-a-va, dân chúng đi tiếp đến Hát-sê-rốt và ở lại tại Hát-sê-rốt.
vi.R: Rồi dân chúng rời Kíp-rốt Ha-tha-a-va và đi đến Hát-sê-rốt, rồi ở lại đó.

decisions.choice: Hazeroth: a camp on the way through the wilderness
decisions.reason: The name means "enclosures" or "settlements". It is the next camp in the list of 33:17, and the story of chapter 12 takes place there (12:16). Its site is not known for certain.

decisions.choice: [to] Hazeroth
decisions.reason: Hebrew can name the goal of a journey without a word for "to". Literal brackets it.
